visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens outdoors on a city street during the day. Four men are standing together; the main character in a cream t-shirt and black NBA cap speaks directly to the camera with active hand gestures. Another man wears a paper mask with a cartoon face. The background features urban buildings and parked cars under bright, natural daylight. (2) The scene transitions to a brightly lit indoor restaurant with textured grey walls. Three men sit around a large round table crowded with multiple dishes, including a whole roasted chicken and bowls of rice. The man in the black shirt eats enthusiastically while the main character explains the rules of their challenge, pointing at the food. (3) Detailed close-ups focus on the food items. A small ceramic pot of dark chicken oil is shown being drizzled over a bowl of white rice with a spoon. The lighting is warm and highlights the textures of the food. The men are seen laughing and reacting to the meal in medium shots. (4) Back outside, the main character has his arm around a friend in a black t-shirt, speaking earnestly. The camera uses a medium shot, capturing their facial expressions and upper bodies. The setting remains the same street as the beginning, with passers-by occasionally visible in the soft-focus background. (5) Indoors on a polished wooden floor, the group plays Twister. Hands and feet are placed on a plastic mat with colored circles. The camera captures the physical struggle and movement as they try to balance. One man eventually loses his balance and collapses onto the floor, leading to a large "GAME OVER" graphic overlay. (6) The main character is shown indoors in a medium close-up, speaking directly to the viewer. He uses calm but authoritative gestures to explain a promotion. Mobile app screenshots and UI elements from Line are overlaid on the screen, showing maps of Hualien and digital stamp collection interfaces with floral icons. (7) A final montage features the four men together in various poses, some pointing or making peace signs. Large red and white text overlays provide details about "Hualien" and the "Hunger Games" theme. The video ends with a summary graphic showing the event title and participants over a blurred restaurant background.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with high-energy male vocals and an upbeat, mid-tempo electronic BGM. The speaker has a friendly, professional tone with a high speech rate and clear articulation. No significant ambient noise is present, suggesting a high-quality field recording or post-produced audio bed. (2) The acoustic environment shifts to an indoor restaurant with a noticeable room tone. Audible ceramics clinking and utensil movements occur as the men interact. Multiple voices overlap with laughter and high-pitched exclamations. The BGM persists as a low-volume background layer, maintaining the energetic mood. (3) A sharp transient impact sound, like a thud, marks a shift in the discussion. The primary speaker's vocal intensity increases as he explains the "Hunger Games" concept. The pitch variability is high, conveying excitement. Background chatter from other group members is audible but stays below the main narration. (4) A distinct, wet splashing sound of liquid being poured is heard during the food close-up. The man who loves rice speaks with a comedic, exaggerated tone, exhibiting high arousal and positive valence. The BGM rhythm is synchronized with the fast-paced editing of the speech. (5) Mechanical clicking sounds from a game spinner are followed by heavy thuds of bodies hitting a wooden floor. Loud, spontaneous laughter from multiple men fills the spectral bandwidth. A synthesized, low-frequency "GAME OVER" sound effect with a digital glitch texture signals the end of the game segment. (6) The main host's voice returns to a steady, narrative prosody with a moderate pitch and professional tone. High-pitched digital UI sound effects like "dings" and "pops" occur frequently to emphasize the app features being described. The BGM swells slightly in volume toward the end, providing a conclusive feel.
